notes.title: Today is Evelynn birthday!
notes.notes: The summer sale is over... But the zombies are still out there! Come, help the survivors get through this nightmare.

notes.title: Summer Sale
notes.notes: With the Summer Sale the manager has gone crazy!!! 50% off Project: Prequel, a unique horror experience with puzzles and real-time combat! Are you missing the feeling of old games? Then come get a nostalgic experience with a wonderful story and interesting characters. Will you be able to survive?

notes.title: Translation Fix
notes.notes:
Hello survivors!
We already know that some "characters" are changing the language while they speak, cof cof translation issue. Soo, we are working on it to fix those translations!
Stay tune and we see you surviving in Project Horror Anthology: Project Prequel!

notes.title: Pre-release
notes.notes:
The inspiration for this game comes from old 16-bit games, so be prepared for challenging battles and puzzles!

If you enjoy difficult challenges, survivor horror, and an intricate and immersive story, we bet that you are going to like it. Come with us and try to survive and solve the mystery behind Project: Prequel.
